footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to NatWest: after £3.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.1% to £30.2B in 2025. Operating income rose 24.4% to £7.7B, a 25.5% margin.
Net income rose 21.4% to £5.8B, or £0.67 per share. Operating cash flow was £7.1B and free cash flow £6.4B, versus £1.3B; NatWest returned £3.0B through dividends and buybacks.
sources: NatWest Group plc Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: NatWest Group, its customers and its counterparties face continued economic and political risks and uncertainties in the UK and global markets…

The implementation and execution of NatWest Group’s strategy carries execution and operational risks and it may not achieve its stated aims…
